name: ct_renal_colic_protocol
description: Order a non-contrast CT (CT KUB) using the renal colic protocol to detect ureteral and renal calculi. This is the gold-standard for urolithiasis evaluation.

region.description: Body region to image (covers kidneys, ureters, bladder)

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., flank pain, hematuria, suspected kidney stone)

when_to_use: acute flank pain or colicky pain radiating to groin
known stone disease with recurrent symptoms
pre-procedural planning for lithotripsy or ureteroscopy
evaluation of stone burden and obstruction

examples.query: Sudden onset severe right flank pain radiating to groin, microscopic hematuria
